sources.title: PDF AeroYOLO: Efficient Multiscale and Attention-Augmented YOLOv8s for ...
sources.snippet: We propose progressively enhanced YOLOv8s-based models AeroYOLO-Fusion, AeroYOLO-Attn, and AeroYOLO-Lite addressing imbalance problems and efficiency challenges through multiscale fusion, attention mechanism, and lightweight architecture.

sources.title: PDF Aero-YOLO: An Efficient Algorithm for Small Object Detection ... - Springer
sources.snippet: First, regarding scale hierarchy reconstruction, the model leverages UAV scale pri-ors to prune the P5 layer, which focuses on macro-scale objects, and introduces a high-resolution P2 layer, enabling the network's receptive field to focus on pixel-level fine-grained features.

sources.title: Aero-YOLO: An Efficient Algorithm for Small Object Detection in UAV ...
sources.snippet: Compared with other mainstream detectors, Aero-YOLO exhibits a superior balance between accuracy and lightweight deployment, providing an efficient solution for real-time UAV detection. The model's robustness is further validated on the UAVOD-10 dataset.
